problems.quote: Resolution 2994 (XXVII) of 1972, which also created the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)
problems.problem: Resolution 2994 (XXVII) established World Environment Day; UNEP was created by Resolution 2997 (XXVII), not 2994.
problems.correction: Resolution 2994 (XXVII) of 1972; UNEP was created by Resolution 2997 (XXVII)
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly attributes UNEP creation to Res 2994; Res 2994 established World Environment Day, Res 2997 created UNEP. Correction is accurate.
